title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
client.gleam enter_demo:
          route:,
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
          demo_mode: True,
model.gleam clear_demo_state:
    demo_mode: False,
    demo_store: None,
    auth: NotAsked,
detail: Verified in the r4 tree: enter_demo overwrites auth unconditionally with the mock landlord and clear_demo_state sets auth NotAsked. A logged-in landlord who opens /demo loses SPA session state and must re-auth client-side on exit despite an intact cookie.
recommended_fix: Stash the pre-demo auth on entry and restore it in clear_demo_state, or re-run auth_api.check_session on demo exit.

title: still present since round 3: demo exit via the banner CTA from a dirty edit page clears demo state first, then the unsaved-changes guard fires against the cleared state
location: client/src/client.gleam:496 (clear before handle_browser_change), 5387-5400 (dirty-edit guard), client/src/model.gleam:747-766 (clear_demo_state field list)
evidence:
client.gleam BrowserChangedUrl:
              handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)
client.gleam guard:
          case model.vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes {
            True -> #(
              Model(
                ..updated_model,
                route: model.route,
                show_unsaved_changes_prompt: True,
model.gleam clear_demo_state resets only: demo_mode, demo_store, auth, vacancies, dashboard_stats, vacancy_detail, vacancy_detail_request_id, leaderboard, application_detail, application_detail_request_id, comparison_details, archived_vacancies, awaiting_list, notifications, unread_count - vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes is NOT among them.
detail: Verified: clear_demo_state runs before handle_browser_change and does not clear vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes, so exiting demo from a dirty edit page prompts and modem.replace's back to /vacancies/<demo-id>/edit with demo_mode now False - 'keep editing' lands on the real edit page for a fixture id, whose save fires a real update_vacancy with the demo CSRF token.
recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clearing demo state, or have clear_demo_state also reset vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes/show_unsaved_changes_prompt when the destination exits the demo.

title: still present since round 3: enter_demo bypasses the navigation reset every other route change performs (dropdowns, pending confirms, consent-modal state, focus trap)
evidence:
enter_demo now resets the modal FIELDS:
          unlock_consent_modal_open: None,
          unlock_consent_checked: False,
          unlock_consent_submitting: False,
          extension_consent_modal_open: None,
but handle_browser_change's effect-side teardown is not replicated:
      effect.batch([
        eff,
        effect.from(fn(_dispatch) { policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall() }),
      ])
grep of the enter_demo body shows no policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall call.
detail: Partially fixed: dropdown/confirm/modal model fields are now reset in enter_demo, but the document-level consent-modal focus-trap listener is never uninstalled on demo entry - a landlord entering /demo with the unlock-consent modal mounted leaves the trap capturing Tab on a page where the modal no longer exists.
recommended_fix: Add the same policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall() effect to enter_demo's returned effects when either consent modal was open.

title: still present since round 3: demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage
detail: Verified: comparison-selection messages are not demo-intercepted and save_comparison_ids has no demo_mode guard; demo interactions write demo ids to the real localStorage keys, which a demo -> signup path then hydrates into real screens.
recommended_fix: Skip save_comparison_ids while model.demo_mode, or namespace demo storage keys.

title: still present since round 3: demo boot skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the page lifetime
detail: Verified: on a demo-first boot the visibility listener and both hydration effects never run for the whole page lifetime, including after the user exits the demo to /signup in the same load.
recommended_fix: Install the listener and hydrations on demo entry too (they are inert while demo_mode), or document the divergence.

title: still present since round 3: latent policy re-acceptance modal could surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST
location: scripts/lint_demo_network.py:55 (UserAcceptedPolicy still EXEMPT_ARMS), client/src/demo/demo_fixtures.gleam:26 (fixture pins accepted_policy_version 2026-05-23), client/src/model.gleam:770 (policy_reaccept_required gate)
evidence:
lint:    "UserAcceptedPolicy",
fixture: ...\"accepted_policy_version\":\"2026-05-23\"}...
model.gleam:    Success(landlord) if model.server_policy_version != "" ->
grep for UserAcceptedPolicy in client/src/demo/demo_update.gleam returns nothing - the message falls through to update_inner, whose arm fires the real accept_policy POST.
detail: Verified: enter_demo does not clear server_policy_version, so an in-SPA demo entry by a landlord whose session carries a server_policy_version newer than the fixture's pinned 2026-05-23 renders the re-accept modal inside the demo; accepting fires a real POST with the demo CSRF token. Latent today (fixture matches current), one policy bump from live.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.handle (no-op + toast) and/or clear server_policy_version in enter_demo.

title: still present since round 3: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry; per-surface analytics undercount the primary entry path
location: client/src/client.gleam:5861-5892 (demo_entry_effects has no capture_event), 5784 (only demo_entry fires), 5214/5320/5348/5434 (per-surface events exist only in handle_browser_change)
detail: Verified: a fresh boot into /vacancies/v-maples counts demo_entry but not demo_vacancy_open, while the identical in-session navigation counts both - shared-URL entries (the primary demo entry path) undercount surface engagement.
recommended_fix: Fire the matching per-surface capture_event in demo_entry_effects' route arms.

title: still present since round 3: comparison deep link passes persisted real localStorage ids into the demo store and skips the navigation path's empty-ids guard
evidence:
routes.Comparison(vid) -> [
      demo_api.fetch_comparison(
        store,
        vid,
        load_comparison_ids(),
        ApiReturnedComparisonDetails,
      ),
    ]
detail: Verified: a demo comparison boot looks up whatever ids happen to be persisted (a real landlord's real UUIDs on a shared machine, or stale demo ids) in the demo store, landing empty/erroring; the navigation path's empty-ids guard is bypassed.
recommended_fix: Mirror the navigation path's empty-ids guard and prefer fixture ids in demo.

title: still present since round 3: failed demo seed desyncs model.route from the browser URL
evidence:
Error(_) -> #(
      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
      effect.none(),
    )
detail: Verified: on seed failure the model renders Landing while the address bar stays on /demo (no modem.replace), and no feedback or session check fires.
recommended_fix: Return modem.replace("/", None, None) in the Error arm so the rendered route matches the URL.

title: still present since round 3: edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame - enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading
detail: Verified: a direct boot into /vacancies/v-maples/edit renders the empty form for the first frame instead of the skeleton, because vacancy_edit_loading stays at its default until the store response lands.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when the boot route is VacancyEdit.

title: still present since round 3: download_timeout duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam with divergent signatures
detail: Verified: both copies still exist and still diverge (parameterised delay vs hardcoded 90s). The store_of half of the r3 duplication note IS fixed - client.gleam's demo_store_of now delegates to demo_update.store_of (5919-5924).
recommended_fix: Lift download_timeout to a shared demo helper (or have demo_update call client.gleam's with 90_000).

title: New demo branches in fire_refcheck_slot_action / fire_refcheck_call_action / save_refcheck_edit are unreachable - demo_update.handle intercepts every message that calls them
location: client/src/client.gleam:7354, 7414, 7557 (dead demo branches) vs client/src/demo/demo_update.gleam:476-541 (intercepting arms)
detail: Verified: in demo mode every message that invokes these three helpers is fully consumed by demo_update.handle, so the new client.gleam demo branches can never execute - duplicate demo refcheck implementations that can silently drift (validation lives only in demo_update's arm).
recommended_fix: Drop the dead demo branches and reclassify the three helpers under the (mechanically checked) DEMO_INTERCEPTED umbrella in the lint manifest, or route demo_update's refcheck arms through the helpers.
